office.name: Office of the Executive Director, Bedford Regional Water Authority
office.place: Bedford Regional Water Authority, Bedford County, Virginia (serves the Town of Bedford and the Forest, Lakes (Smith Mountain Lake), Stewartsville and other areas of Bedford County); main office 1723 Falling Creek Road, Bedford, VA 24523
office.remit: A water and sewer authority created in 2012 by the Bedford County Board of Supervisors and the Bedford City (now Town) Council under the Virginia Water and Waste Authorities Act (Va. Code 15.2-5100 et seq.). It treats and distributes drinking water, collects and treats wastewater, bills customers monthly, sets rates and connection fees after a public hearing (Va. Code 15.2-5136), builds and finances capital projects (including state revolving fund loans) and awards contracts. A seven-member board of directors appointed by the Board of Supervisors and the Town Council sets policy, adopts the budget and rates, and awards major contracts; it meets the third Tuesday of each month at 7:00 p.m. The executive director, hired by the board, runs daily operations, staff, purchasing, customer service and communications. Staff are Authority employees paid from utility revenues (no tax funding).

succession.rule: Va. Code 15.2-5113: 'The board members may appoint a chief administrative or executive officer who shall serve at the pleasure of the board members.' The Authority's bylaws (Operating Policy 1.30, Article III.5.b): 'The members shall hire an Executive Director to oversee and manage the daily operation of the Authority.' The Personnel Committee performs the executive director's annual evaluation (Article V.1.c.i). Board members are appointed by the Bedford County Board of Supervisors and the Town of Bedford Council for four-year terms (Articles of Incorporation, Article III).
succession.timeline: Fri Sept 4, 2026: previous executive director's retirement effective. Sept 5-20: Assistant Executive Director Teresa Halvorsen serves as acting executive director. Tue Sept 15: regular board meeting; the board, on the Personnel Committee's recommendation, votes 6-1 to hire Warren Kessinger (one member preferred to keep the acting director through December). Mon Sept 21: Kessinger starts. Tue Sept 22: news release.
